posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
arenson9:

Do they not provide a free text field where you can write what you want? Does it take more than a sentence to write why you haven't bought the app?

It's a single-line text field, not a text block.  It's not a huge deal obviously, but you wouldn't expect people to write much of an explanation in a small field like that.  I would imagine you'd get more "didn't get it because it's not fun" answers rather than "here's why I think it's not fun" explanations.

Sounds like they're getting what they wanted, so it's no big deal.
